reuse.why: Puts the check in the existing pre-link guard ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, which every provider's link handler already calls first, and reuses APIError and db.first.

duplication.why: A single check added once; no per-provider copies.

placement.why: The guard is the right layer (runs before any bank row is created or sync starts), but a closed-account check inside a function named ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked blurs its name; a renamed or sibling guard would read better.

scope.why: Only the guard and two focused tests.

maintainability.why: Small and covered by tests for both the new-link and relink cases; the only cost is the function name no longer describing all it checks.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers (GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy, Akahu, Enable Banking, Fintegra) reach the rule through ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked.

one_place.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts, called at the start of every provider's link handler.
